metadata.short_desc: Realistic life memory and daily routine layer for AI personas
metadata.desc: Provides a realistic life memory layer for AI personas: daily routine planning, tracking daily minor events and ongoing events, and dynamic prompt injection to keep daily life vivid and consistent.

enabled.hint: When disabled, life recording and daily planning will stop. Existing data will remain on disk.

inject_guide.hint: Injects usage guidance into prompts each round. Disable this if instructions are already integrated into your persona card to save ~230 chars/round.

small_ttl_hours.hint: How long past minor events are retained. Defaults to 24 hours (1 day) before fading.

ongoing_ttl_hours.hint: Fallback TTL to prevent forgotten ongoing events from lingering indefinitely. Defaults to 168 hours (7 days).

max_events.hint: Maximum capacity of the life event pool to prevent bloat. Defaults to 60.

storage_scope.hint: persona: isolate life lines by persona; global: share a single life line across all personas.

enable_holiday.hint: Automatically recognizes statutory and traditional holidays to enrich context and mood.

enable_outfit.hint: Allows AI personas to perceive daily outfits and styling in today's state.

history_plan_days.hint: Number of previous days' plans to reference (0-7) when planning a new day. Defaults to 2.

enable_persona_whitelist.hint: When enabled, only personas in the whitelist will have Life Memory active.

persona_whitelist.hint: List of persona IDs allowed to use life memory (e.g. default, cat_girl).

session_list_mode.hint: all: active for all sessions; whitelist: only in whitelist; blacklist: disabled in blacklist.

session_list.hint: Unified Message Origin list, e.g. aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456.

dashboard.title: Life Memory Dashboard
dashboard.description: View and manage life memories, daily plans, and event timelines.
